operator.measured_vs_stated: measured: host, target and PCI identity; stated: host label, card label and operator notes

inventory.topology.coverage: Raw lspci tree and resource maps retained under inventory/.

vendor.extended.coverage: Swept 0x00-0xFF of all three banks with no descriptor matched, so the values are measured and unattributed: nothing here names a register or claims a meaning. Above the standard range and not 0xFF — crtc 230, graphics 232, sequencer 251.

vga.attribute.coverage: AR00-AR14. The flip-flop phase on entry is unobservable and is not restored; the index and its Palette Address Source bit are written back.

vga.dac_mask_state.coverage: DAC type not identified in v1; one mask read may advance a hidden counter.

vga.dac_palette.coverage: All 256 entries, three 6-bit values each, read through the DAC read pointer. The pointer's entry value is unobservable; it exits at 0.
